forum.title: Report a User ?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil ,

Indeed, it’s not possible to report a user. You can only report their activity: questions or replies.

if you have concerns about users without any activity, you can report them by sending a DM to ​@Maxime\_MARCHETTO1 .

Kind regards,

Lina
forum.content_text:
The old forum had a facility to report a User Profile; eg, an inappropriate avatar or username or for spamming.

This was separate from reporting Posts.

I don’t see that on the new forum ?
forum.author: Andrew Neil
